highlights.name: Zoro Wallet
highlights.stack: Node.js, Koa, React Native, Expo, Canton Network, DAML
bullets: Own and lead end-to-end architecture, development, and delivery for the flagship Canton-based Zoro Wallet, supporting 5 digital assets for a rapidly scaling userbase of 45K+.
Pioneered integration of CIP-0103 standard, designing robust RPC-based routing across the wallet ecosystem.
Designed and implemented a modular wallet integration framework: seamless multi-wallet transaction flows, real-time event listeners, and cross-wallet handler engines.
Built dynamic, asset-agnostic fee computation modules optimizing transaction costs for users across the Canton network.
Drove protocol extensibility—including token onboarding, and scalable, secure on-chain/cross-chain swaps via multi-partner integrations.

highlights.name: Zoro APIs & Transaction Scaling
highlights.stack: Node.js, Koa, Golang, Canton Network, DAML
bullets: Drove $300K+ CC incremental revenue by optimizing transaction management: predictive reward gating, advanced node monitoring, and 24/7 high-availability infrastructure stewardship.
Engineered reward-gating and bot transfer logic to maximize ecosystem earnings and minimize revenue leakage.
Scaled Zoro APIs for high throughput (8 TPS) and 99.99% uptime, introducing advanced rate limiting and hot path optimizations for peak loads.
Provisioned and managed 45,000+ fully-automated transfer accounts across 3 nodes, enabling reliable, secure swaps and token transfers using ed25519-hd-key and bip-39 keys.
Architected a high-frequency transaction pipeline—processing 300K+ transactions daily with robust monitoring and failover.

highlights.name: Trade.fast
highlights.stack: Node.js, Fastify, Canton Network, DAML, Next.js, Solidity
bullets: Built dynamic, real-time leaderboards underpinning trader and liquidity pool rankings; automated reward payout flows based on standing.
Developed a granular, quest-level attribution system for referral tracking and campaign measurement.
Engineered an analytics-driven Uniswap V2-like UI, surfacing actionable insights and token data history for liquidity providers.
Secured client-side transaction signing using WebAuth and encrypted seed phrases, elevating user experience and compliance standards.
Co-developed Canton-based AMM and liquidity pool smart contracts, scaling protocol to 15K+ swaps/day at peak.

highlights.name: Bridge — ERC20 on Canton
highlights.stack: DAML, Solidity, Smart contracts, Next.js, Fastify
bullets: Delivered seamless ERC20 bridging for Canton: launched on testnet with robust swap and App assurance features.
Designed and exposed APIs bridging backend, DAML, and Ethereum smart contracts for streamlined, fail-safe bridge operations.
Built a full-stack node and transaction monitoring dashboard, enabling real-time visibility and proactive operations.

highlights.name: Featured App Rewards
bullets: Developed an ML-driven prediction algorithm to optimize marker-based reward distributions for user submissions.
Automated multi-signal marker submission pipelines and programmatic traffic acquisition, resulting in significant growth and platform visibility.

highlights.name: COMET
highlights.stack: C++, Python, Wireshark, HTTP, TLS 1.2, TCP/UDP, SIP/RTP, STUN/TURN
bullets: Led research and core POC/production delivery of COMET (KSA) as part of a $300M federal-grade lawful interception initiative, with a focus on DPI and correlation modules.
Orchestrated the design and deployment of scalable DPI systems: achieving 10M+ session analytics per day across L2–L7, with best-in-class correlation performance.
Authored high-accuracy VoIP correlation mechanisms for encrypted traffic, consistently surpassing 95% accuracy over multi-million session daily scale.
Implemented advanced C++ TLS traffic reconstruction using libgcrypt for real-time PCAP decryption and analytics.
Optimized and scaled distributed data pipelines across 54 nodes, handling over 10M records per day with sub-millisecond latency.

highlights.name: MetaTrail
highlights.stack: C++, Python, Wireshark, FoIP, SRTP, NLP
bullets: Engineered robust Fax over IP (FoIP) to TIFF workflows—delivering automated processing at 95%+ accuracy benchmarks.
Developed WAV extraction modules from SRTP streams by leveraging SIP session key analysis.
Enabled location-aware traffic analysis at sub-district scale (Tehsil level) to support J&K precision surveillance.
Pioneered SMTP session extraction, with applied NLP for advanced conversation analytics and intent inference.

highlights.name: Singular
bullets: Developed signature-based multi-protocol classification system, accurately segmenting diverse application traffic genres.
Reverse engineered QUIC session headers, enabling extraction and decryption for session identification and analytics.
Delivered game traffic correlation modules resulting in enhanced identification of multiplayer online sessions in real time.

highlights.name: Platform
bullets: Spearheaded rapid product delivery, launching ECal, CiP, and EmX from inception to production—driving adoption across 10+ enterprise organizations.
Engineered asynchronous API triggers and intelligent automation pipelines to power CI/CD and DevOps flows via GitHub Actions.
Built and scaled a highly discoverable, SEO-optimized public website—achieving 500+ daily organic visitors in <3 months.
Integrated Stripe for robust billing: automated webhook handling, idempotent payment flows, and PDF invoice generation for a seamless customer experience.

highlights.name: ChatGP.se
bullets: Built a multi-tenant, production-scale ChatGPT platform powering 10,000+ users with advanced admin analytics and segmentation.
Achieved ~3x reduction in OpenAI token usage by designing a Redis-powered semantic caching system, persistent conversation memory, and targeted content crawling to enhance grounding.
Drove the complete SDLC (from ideation to deployment) for two robust, user-facing production products.

Weather-aware re-planning with Maps + OpenWeather.
Firebase Auth/Firestore; INR budget engine by category.

Optimized EC commitment verification pipeline.

Redis cache, BullMQ jobs; file explorer with live analytics.
